name: CERN Technical Studentship
nextText: Check careers.cern for the next intake

eligibility.note: Nationals of CERN Member or Associate Member States only. Applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot, Croatian and Turkish nationals are currently not considered (associate-member ceiling reached).

countryNotes.PK: Pakistani nationals are currently not considered (associate-member ceiling reached).
countryNotes.TR: Turkish nationals are currently not considered (associate-member ceiling reached).

fields: Engineering, applied physics, IT, maths, robotics, materials science
note: Paid technical or engineering placement at CERN for students still enrolled at university, usually needed for a degree internship or thesis. The 2027-1 round (start ~1 Apr 2027) closed on 16 Oct 2026.

name: CERN Doctoral Student Programme
nextText: Check careers.cern for the next round

eligibility.note: Nationals of CERN Member or Associate Member States only. Applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot, Croatian and Turkish nationals are currently not considered (associate-member ceiling reached).

note: Lets PhD students do their thesis research at CERN with a CERN allowance. The 2027-1 round closed on 16 Oct 2026; check the careers site for the allowance and the next round.

name: CERN openlab Summer Student Programme
dlText: ~end Jan 2027 (estimated from past cycles; time not stated)

eligibility.note: Check nationality rules on the openlab FAQ and the careers.cern posting.

note: A 9-week summer programme on computing projects at CERN, with applications on the CERN careers portal opening in early November 2026. The deadline is estimated from past cycles (late January). Replies come by early April 2027.

name: ESA Graduate Trainee Programme (formerly YGT)
dlText: ~early Mar 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle: vacancies published each February, open ~1 month; time not stated)
tags: Master's graduates within 1 year of graduation

eligibility.note: Citizens of ESA Member States, Associate Members or Cooperating States only; the full list is in the footer of each vacancy.

note: An entry-level traineeship for recent Master's graduates or final-year Master's students, who must graduate before starting. Vacancies are published every February.
